text: Welcome to Leichhardt. I'm Clara. We'll explore the rooms of this house, then reveal the structure and examine a window. Point a controller at a button and squeeze the trigger. Next room moves you gently with a short fade; you decide when to continue. Use the right stick to turn in small steps. Press the A button on your right controller to hide or show the guide. When you bring it back, it will find a clear position beside your view. When you're ready, choose Next room to enter the hall.
